_doc: Revert-verify mutants for ticket e3bac7b5 / req f28051a9 (validate schema --shapes-mode names the REASONS behind its warning count on the default text surface). Run from the repo root: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py packages/cli/tests/integration/validate-schema-warning-breakdown-e3bac7b5.spec.json after setting `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout (both absolute; the spec is committed with a placeholder so a run never mutates a neighbouring session's worktree — integration-test-revert-verify §A76). Guards enumerated from `git diff -U0` (§A8). EVERY axis asserts PRINTED TEXT (§A66): the data behind the breakdown is already collected inside the command and already shipped by --format json / --format earl, so an axis on the internal structure or on either machine branch would pass on the pre-fix code too. TWO guards of the diff carry NO mutant, and the honest reason (§A118) is that neither has an input on which it defends a legal form: (1) `case "unknown-property"` — that constraint is emitted only under ValidatorOptions.closedWorldMode, and runShapesValidation never passes options at all (measured by reading it), so no live warning can carry it; (2) `if (target === undefined || target === "")` inside the class arm — ShaclLiteValidator's class branch passes `actualValue: obj.value` on every push (:455-465), so the bucket is unreachable today and exists so a future emitter that omits the target is NAMED rather than folded into a real reason.

M3_symbolic_bucket_mislabelled._note: A non-obsidian target is a symbolic term IRI; calling it absent loses the distinction the ticket exists for.

M4_default_arm_returns_a_class_reason._note: An emitter with no actualValue (minCount) must bucket by constraint, never as a class reason.

M6_tiebreak_dropped._note: Without the reason tie-break, equal counts follow arrival order — byte-stability of the block is gone.

M8_breakdown_never_printed._note: The EFFECT mutant (§A97): the whole point of the ticket is the printed block.

M9_printed_outside_the_warning_guard._note: Placement: the block belongs INSIDE `if (warningResults.length > 0)`, so a clean vault stays silent. The hoisted copy is byte-faithful (padStart + its own width) ON PURPOSE — the first draft printed it unpadded, which reddened WB9 as well and made the mutant read as unaddressed (§A43).
